title: Carrack (Anvil Aerospace, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Carrack is a big expedition explorer from Anvil Aerospace in Star Citizen, flown from a bridge by a crew of six to twelve. It has turrets, a room for drones and scanning, and a hangar. The pilot has no guns, so the trigger only does something in modes such as scanning or quantum travel.

panels.name: Carrack: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Carrack's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: No pilot guns
controls.text: The Carrack has no guns for the pilot; the trigger acts only in scanning or quantum mode.
controls.context: Without own guns the pilot flies, uses the missiles where fitted and leaves the shooting to the crew in the turrets.

controls.name: Cargo (456 SCU)
controls.text: The Carrack holds 456 SCU of cargo for long journeys. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Carrack: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Carrack besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Bridge
controls.text: The pilot and co-pilot stations sit at the front of the bridge, with screens (MFDs).
controls.context: The bridge is the ship's command room; the pilot steers, the co-pilot helps with systems.

controls.name: Turret stations
controls.text: Three manned turrets and one remote turret protect the ship.
controls.context: A turret seat has its own controls: there the right stick aims the turret instead of steering the ship.

controls.name: Hangar (Pisces and Ursa)
controls.text: A hangar carries a Pisces, a small snub craft, and an Ursa ground rover.
controls.context: The small craft and the rover explore places where the big ship cannot go.

panels.name: Right stick (flight stick)
panels.text: The right-hand stick steers the ship's nose and does the fighting: it fires the weapons, picks targets and holds the buttons for radar, quantum travel, scanning and mining.
panels.context: This is the game's own two-stick preset for the Thrustmaster T.16000M. Many buttons change their job with the operator mode shown on the HUD; the stick's base buttons 5 to 16 sit on the stick's foot.

controls.name: Trigger
controls.text: This ship has no pilot guns, so the trigger works only in the operator modes. In quantum mode, holding it starts the jump of the quantum drive.
controls.context: The destination is chosen on the star map first; in scanning or mining mode the trigger does that mode's job instead.
